name: Sugawara Chronicle
source:
Hiroya Tachibana doesn't need anyone's help. At least that's what he told himself on the night his father threw him out. Day by day he goes to school, keeping his head down to draw as little attention as possible. But between a vicious rivalry with the private school across town, a friend who can't go one day without getting in trouble, and a strange rumor surrounding a mysterious transfer student, Hiroya finds it impossible not to get distracted, while his own life crumbles around him.  Will he make his own way and become a champion of his school? Will he delve into the lives of his classmates? Forge new relationships? Or will he spend his senior year sleeping under the bridge that divides the town? It's up to you to decide. 

Sugawara Chronicle is an anime inspired choice-based VN which splits into two distinct paths early in the game. One route will have you team up with a group of club leaders on a mission to save you school the villainous private academy and their student body president. The other route will take you into the daily life of a girl who can't help but get involved in some mischief wherever she goes. The two stories, while played independently, are highly connected, and lead to a third unlockable route in which you can have a chance to learn the true nature of the phenomena at Sugawara High. 

[From [url=https://sarchalen.itch.io/sugawara-chronicle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
橘博也不需要任何人的帮助。至少，在父亲把他赶出家门的那晚，他是这样告诉自己的。每天，他低着头去上学，尽量不引人注意。但城另一端私立学校的恶毒竞争、一天不惹麻烦就难受的朋友，以及围绕神秘转校生的奇怪传闻，让博也不可能不分心，而他自己的生活也在身边逐渐崩塌。

他会走出自己的道路，成为学校的冠军吗？会深入了解同学们的生活吗？会建立新的关系吗？还是会把高中最后一年都耗在分隔城镇的桥下？由你决定。

《菅原编年史》是一部受动画启发、以选择为核心的视觉小说，游戏早期分为两条截然不同的路线。一条路线中，你会与社团领袖们组队，对抗邪恶私立学院及其学生会长，拯救自己的学校。另一条路线带你体验一名女孩的日常生活，她总是忍不住卷入恶作剧。两段故事可以独立游玩，却高度关联，并通向第三条可解锁路线；在那里，你有机会了解菅原高中现象的真正本质。

[来源：[url=https://sarchalen.itch.io/sugawara-chronicle]Itch.io[/url]]
